theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1 + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ y : Euclid (n + 1 + k), ∃ v w, y = ι v + ι' w) → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ h R : ℝ, 0 < h → ∀ φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 R → (∀ v, ‖φ v‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (n + 1 + k))) n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) n) ⊆ ball 0 (R + 2 * h) ∧ (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) n) y) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (g : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid k) (v : Euclid (n + 1)), DifferentiableAt ℝ g v → ‖g v‖ < h → exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + 1 + k)) n) (ι v + ι' (g v)) (fun j => fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) v (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = K⁻¹ * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ v).toLinearMap
